exercises.title: Descriptive Naming
exercises.description: Use clear, descriptive names for tests and keywords.
instructions: Create test 'Verify User Can Login With Valid Credentials' (descriptive)
Create keyword 'Enter Username And Password' with [Arguments] ${user} ${pass}
Call the keyword from the test
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add descriptive test

*** Keywords ***
# Add descriptive keyword
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Verify User Can Login With Valid Credentials
    Enter Username And Password    admin    secret

*** Keywords ***
Enter Username And Password
    [Arguments]    ${user}    ${pass}
    Log    Entering ${user} and password
hints: Names should explain what, not how

exercises.title: DRY Principle - Don't Repeat Yourself
exercises.description: Extract repeated code into reusable keywords.
instructions: Then uses Should Be Equal to verify
Create test that verifies: name=John, age=30, role=admin
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add test that verifies multiple fields

*** Keywords ***
# Add reusable verification keyword
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Verify User Data
    ${name}    Set Variable    John
    ${age}    Set Variable    30
    ${role}    Set Variable    admin
    Verify Field Value    name    John
    Verify Field Value    age    30
    Verify Field Value    role    admin

*** Keywords ***
Verify Field Value
    [Arguments]    ${field}    ${expected}
    Log    Verifying ${field} = ${expected}
hints: Changes needed in only one place

exercises.title: Test Independence
exercises.description: Ensure tests don't depend on each other's state.
instructions: Each test creates its own variable (no shared state)
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add two independent tests
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
First Test
    ${counter}    Set Variable    1
    Log    Counter in first test: ${counter}

Second Test
    ${counter}    Set Variable    10
    Log    Counter in second test: ${counter}
hints: Each test sets up its own data
Tests can run in any order

exercises.title: Meaningful Assertions
exercises.description: Add clear failure messages to assertions.
instructions: Use Should Be Equal with custom message:
Should Be Equal    ${status}    active    msg=Status should be active
